purpose: Durable operating context for dashboard maintenance; load this and current monitor issues before investigating. Chat memory is not the source of truth.

monitor.cadence: Health checks hourly at minute 17 UTC; daily postgame accuracy sample at 6:00 AM America/New_York; critical workflow completion events
monitor.notifications: Assigned persistent GitHub issues; delivery depends on the owner's GitHub notification settings
monitor.limitations: GitHub schedules are best-effort. This is not continuous agent supervision, independent external uptime monitoring, or a proof of every statistic.

sources.challengeVideo: Only official reviews-by-day PDF dmmx2 links; never substitute clock clips into Video.
sources.challengeClock: Validated timeActual-based clips, separate from PDF Video and whistle attribution. Version 4 accepts source-backed corrected incidents and immediate/continuously clocked challenge stoppages, never delayed reviews or intervening free throws. November 4 extension verifies sub-100ms correction/timeout clusters, PDF-backed clock adjustments, and gamebook-named cleared-defender blocks; gamebook evidence must match the challenging team. A stale CDN final box can no longer reject PBP that reconciles with the preserved primary final score; backup-only score validation remains strict. Daily maintenance retries missing links; hourly health records coverage. November 4 adjudication: 207/246 linked (was 192/246), 39 retained unavailable with specific reasons, none outdated. All 13 WAS challenges, including preseason, now have Clock links. All protected non-Clock fields verified unchanged across 78 repaired raw records, with all seven current-season caches refreshed serially. Evidence and backups: local output/audit-repairs/20261104-clock-adjudication. Presence does not certify NBA playback availability.
sources.challengeInventory: Check both 2026-27 and legacy 2025-26 official.nba.com URLs. Verify PDF fingerprint, expected document row count, and completion markers, not only workflow exit status.
sources.originalCall: Weekly PDF initial call plus gamebook original-call evidence, not the corrected event or following possession.
sources.challengeReview: November 4 review fix: daily gamebooks match by team and period; clock adjustments up to two seconds require a unique ledger-backed team/type/outcome concordance, with all PDF entries in that game considered even during filtered retries. Published clocks, stable IDs, manual decisions and user annotations are preserved. Gamebook hashes and clock-match evidence are retained. Stored needs_review remains retryable, but UI/monitor distinguish whistle_unavailable (a confirmed call without a published official) from original_whistle_unverified, source_conflict, gamebook_pending and other actionable review. Applied 19 authoritative attribution resolutions, including PHI Q4 0:31.7 (Kevin Scott), IND Q4 3:28 (Brent Barnaky), LAL Q1 0:33.1 (Tony Brothers) on October 30. Verified all 82 current-season official whistle totals against competitive authoritative rows; all 30 team profiles, unrelated call metrics and existing Clock/PDF Video links unchanged. Remaining: 34 actionable cases (18 original-whistle unverified, 11 pending book matches, two source conflicts, three other), plus 29 known unpublished whistles. The three October 30 replacement-label cases remain unverified for original whistle; sampled official clips did not establish it unambiguously. Evidence/backups: local output/audit-repairs/20261104-challenge-review-adjudication. Do not call all 63 stored flags source conflicts or imply an automated retry adjudicates them.
sources.officialIdentity: Permanent NBA official identity, never jersey number alone.
sources.recordScope: Preseason visible in log; regular-season and playoff challenges count toward official competitive records.
